page.layout: One printed page (right of scan): running head top centre with page number at top right; text in one column; a horizontal rule divides the page; a second section below; signature line at the foot. No marginal notes.

p.i: DI faciant, uti diu sint! plus plusq; sospitent istuc, quod nunc habes.

main_text.p: Quisque pro opibus suis frugaliter debet vivere: ut servi, more servorum.

p.i: Servo homini modeste melius facere sumtum, quam ampliter.

main_text.p: De magnis divitiis si quid demas, non fit plus, sed minus. Parsimoniae igitur studendum.
main_text.head: FRUGUM. FRUMENTI. MESSIS. PAPAVERIS.
main_text.p: FRUMENTUM demetiebantur modio, trimodio, & ipso horreo.

page.notes: The heading is set in spaced capitals; the text of the Latin words "Ful-" at the foot is a catchword fragment. Some words in the upper lines are doubtful, notably "plusq;" and "sospitent" which may be misprinted. The red mark after "Quisque" is a stain, not text.
